source.license: Work of the U.S. Government (FAA), not subject to U.S. copyright under 17 U.S.C. 105; the handbook carries no copyright notice. Third-party images are credited in the front-matter Acknowledgments (p. v) by chapter (e.g. Ch. 6: Piaggio P-180 photo, autopilot imagery; Ch. 7: oxygen equipment, TKS; Ch. 8: avionics/ADC/AHRS images). None of the selected figures is among them or carries a credit or copyright line. A generic line thanks Cessna and other manufacturers for images 'used throughout' without naming figures. Suggested attribution: 'Source: FAA, Pilot's Handbook of Aeronautical Knowledge (FAA-H-8083-25C), Figure N.'
source.coordinates: All bboxes/points are image pixels of the listed PNG (origin top-left, x right, y down). bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1]. label_bbox = printed label (orange label box when present, else the text span), from PyMuPDF vector extraction; shape_bbox and path points from gridded visual inspection, verified on *.check.png.
source.method: PyMuPDF 1.28.2 render of the vector figure regions (clip + matrix); no OCR needed (all figure text is vector text). tesseract is not installed.

controls.notes: High-wing single drawn in oblique top view, nose to the lower left. The near (lower-right) wing is the airplane's LEFT wing (red wingtip light). Surfaces are not individually labeled on the drawing; the printed labels are the axis captions (Aileron-Roll, Elevator-Pitch, Rudder-Yaw) and the table rows (label_table_bbox). shape_polys give tighter polygons for the diagonal trailing-edge surfaces.

cylinder_numbering.value: Cylinders numbered front to rear, odd numbers on the right, even on the left; left/right as seen by an observer facing the rear of the engine (front = propeller end). So #1 is right-front, #2 left-front, #3 right-rear, #4 left-rear.
